items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. There is no dialogue or narrative from Norman Simmons indicating a personal, professional, or musical relationship with Monk Rowe beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Norman was interviewed in Clinton, New York on September 27, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m director of the Jazz Archive here at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Norman Simmons here for a second interview and have you at the college for some musical events. Welcome.
Thank you very much. It’s a pleasure to be here again.
